title: DefAn: Definitive Answer Dataset for LLMs Hallucination Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating factual hallucinations in LLMs across eight specific domains: Sports, Census Australia, Nobel, Entertainment, World organizations, QS ranking, Conference Venue, and Math. It does not include benchmarks or evaluations related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics; 'ethics' is only mentioned as a potential domain for future versions of the dataset in the limitations section.
